author: Inside Edition
description: As we continue to mourn the loss of Dolly Parton, Inside Edition has uncovered a lost gem from the video vault. We all know that Dolly was an amazing singer, actor and songwriter, but what many may not know is that early in her career, she was also a reality star. Early in her legendary career, Dolly appeared on the show "Candid Camera," helping pull off some hilarious pranks. The iconic Dolly Parton died last week at the age of 80.
title: Watch Unearthed Dolly Parton 'Candid Camera' Appearances

author: Inside Edition
description: Two years ago, Mica Miller's body was found in a North Carolina park. Authorities ruled her death a suicide, but her friends and family didn't believe it, pointing the finger at her ex-husband, a charismatic pastor. Secrets of their relationship are revealed in a new true crime docuseries, "Death of a Pastor's Wife." The series is now the No. 1 show on Netflix, as Inside Edition's Steven Fabian reports.
title: Details About Pastor And Ex-Wife Mica Miller's Marriage Revealed

author: Inside Edition
description: We're seeing newly released bodycam video showing the moment cops found a star soccer player's body in a Jeep. Karoline Heintz was getting ready to begin her collegiate athletic career in Pennsylvania when she was killed last month. Her high school sweetheart Royce Moser is being charged in her death. His mother Rachel Moser is also in custody, accused of trying to cover up a crime. Inside Edition's Justin Finch reports on the case.
title: Newly-Released Bodycam Shows Moment Cops Found Teen Soccer Star's Body

author: Inside Edition
description: A man swimming off the shore of Malibu in southern California had no idea he was being circled by a great white shark! In fact, he returned to the beach, and it wasn't until a drone operator showed him the video that he realized his close encounter with the aquatic predator. Wildlife experts say young great white sharks often swim close to the shore in Malibu, to feed and grow in the shallow surf. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian has more.
title: Malibu Swimmer Shocked To Learn He Was Being Circled By Great White Shark

author: Inside Edition
description: After six-and-a-half days of deliberations in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial, the jury could not agree on a unanimous decision, and the judge declared a mistrial. Clancy was accused of killing her three children during what she says was a bout of postpartum psychosis. The defendant looked straight ahead, showing no emotion, as her trial came to an end without a resolution. Inside Edition's Alison Hall is at the courthouse in Plymouth, Massachusetts.
title: Lindsay Clancy Trial Ends In Mistrial

author: Inside Edition
description: There has been massive interest in the Lindsay Clancy case, and opinions on it have divided the country, often down gender lines. Many women support Clancy, while men generally see her as a cold-blooded killer. The case has even become a sort of litmus test in the dating world, with singles asking each other's take on the trial before going on a second date. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports.
title: How The Lindsay Clancy Case Has Entered The Dating World

author: Inside Edition
description: Kirkland Police were called for a possible burglary after a resident heard banging coming from inside their house. When police arrived, they found this: a bobcat hanging out at the top of the stairs. They used an unmanned aircraft to get up close and personal to the cat burglar so they could monitor it while also keeping a safe distance. As expected, the cat wasn't interested in being anywhere near any drones or humans. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Bobcat Breaks Into Washington State Home
